thread:
cece: Heads up — onboarding demo failed: tool_call args became a string after auth retry during a streamed response, helper schema returned {}, UI showed empty card.

sam: Which SDK and flow?

cece: Node SDK, jsonMode + streaming + tool_call helper. Repro: force a 401 on first chunk so retry path triggers. After retry the logged body looked like:

```
{"tool_call": {"name":"lookup","args":"{\"id\":\"42\"}"}}
```

marta: I saw the same in yesterday's run. Helper assumed args was object and returned empty. I patched helper to try JSON.parse when args is a string which fixed the demo.

olga: FYI Python SDK normalizes responses at transport, so it doesn't hit this. Node parity issue.

sam: Short-term helper parse is fine, long-term we should stop double-serializing in the retry/transport path. I'll spike on transport ordering.

ci-bot: Created DEVEX-1209: "node: normalize response objects after retry to avoid stringified tool args".

marta: Action items: (1) land helper defensive parse (marta), (2) add sample-app integration test that simulates 401->200 streaming and asserts args are objects (cece), (3) transport spike and fix in node SDK (sam), (4) add parity note in SDK README (olga).

cece: Test added to sample-app branch as a flaky repro harness.

sam: I'll instrument retry flow and post a small RFC. Theory: replay uses a cached string template instead of JSON.stringify when re-emitting chunks. If so, replace with JSON.stringify and add a response normalizer.

marta: Leaving helper guard until transport fix and tests land. Ping me for PR review.

olga: We'll add a cross-SDK test after node fix to prevent regressions.

cece: TL;DR: onboarding blank caused by stringified tool args on retry in node streaming; patched helper, tests+core fix in flight.
